name: XENO STORE
author: XENOKING
description: PS5 game store + download manager by XENOKING. Opens on the TV, serves the store on :9095, keeps downloading while the browser is closed, auto-installs PKGs, backs up saves and more.

payloads.name: XENO STORE
payloads.notes: The whole store in one ELF. It opens on the TV when it starts (Settings → General), serves http://<ps5-ip>:9095 (or http://xeno.local:9095) to your phone and PC, and keeps downloading with the browser closed. Recommended for Payload Manager auto-start.
